description: Look up how recipes are filed, or remove a legacy category. taxonomy: the allowed course/main/cuisine/diet/method/occasion values to use in save_recipe and update_recipe (read-only). list: the user's own app categories with recipe counts (read-only). unassign: remove categories from one recipe (write, new revision). Returns {taxonomy} | {categories:[{path, recipes}]} | {id, categories}.

paths.description: unassign only: category paths to remove, e.g. ["Desserts > Pies"]

name: manage_categories
title: Filing lists and categories
